title: Build initial heterostructure supercells
action: Construct atomic structures for the monolayers α-P, β-P, H-MoSe2, T-MoSe2, ZT-MoSe2, SO-MoSe2 starting from published lattice constants. Build the five heterostructures using the given supercell multiplicities and a vacuum of ≈20 Å.
description: Prepare all initial structures for DFT. The supercell dimensions and vacuum follow the paper's construction.

title: DFT geometry optimization of all systems
action: Perform DFT geometry optimization for every monolayer and heterostructure using SIESTA with the vdW-DRSLL functional, DZP basis, and Troullier-Martins pseudopotentials. Relax until forces are below a well-converged threshold.
description: Core reference calculation yielding equilibrium geometries and total energies needed for all subsequent property evaluations.

title: Compute electronic band structures and work functions
action: For all relaxed structures, perform non-self-consistent band structure calculations and obtain Kohn-Sham eigenvalues, density of states, and work functions.
description: Generates electronic structure data required for band gap analysis and Schottky barrier determination.

title: External electric field calculations for semiconducting heterostructures
action: For α-P/H-MoSe2 and β-P/H-MoSe2, apply uniform perpendicular electric fields of -1.0, -0.5, 0.5, 1.0 V/Å and recompute the band structure.
description: Provides data for field-dependent band gap tuning.

title: Strain-energy calculations for elastic properties
action: For each relaxed structure, generate a 5×5 grid of in-plane strain states by independently changing lattice constants x and y from -0.02 to 0.02 in steps of 0.01. Perform DFT single-point energy calculations for each strained configuration.
description: Strain energies will be fitted to extract in-plane stiffness and Poisson's ratios.

title: Dielectric function calculation
action: Using the ground-state Kohn-Sham orbitals, compute the complex dielectric function via first-order time-dependent perturbation theory as implemented in SIESTA for all monolayers and heterostructures.
description: Provides dielectric constants for the final scored artifact.

title: Compute structural properties
action: From the relaxed geometries and total energies, compute lattice constants a and b, lattice mismatch, interlayer distance, and binding energy per atom. Write to structural_properties.json.
description: Records structural quantities: a, b, mismatch, interlayer distance, binding energy per atom.
output_schema: Array of objects with keys: system, a, b, lattice_mismatch (float|null), interlayer_distance (float|null), binding_energy_per_atom (float|null)

title: Compute electronic properties
action: Extract band gaps, band gap types, field-dependent band gaps for semiconducting heterostructures, and Schottky barrier heights/types for metallic heterostructures. Write to electronic_properties.json.
description: Electronic headline results: band gaps, field-tuning, Schottky barriers.
output_schema: Array of objects with keys: system, band_gap (float|null), band_gap_type (string|null), band_gap_vs_field (null or array of {field: float, band_gap: float}), schottky_barrier_height (float|null), schottky_barrier_type (string|null)

title: Compute mechanical properties
action: Fit strain-energy data to quadratic form and compute in-plane stiffness Cx, Cy (N/m) and Poisson's ratios vx, vy. Write to mechanical_properties.json.
output_schema: Array of objects with keys: system, Cx, Cy, vx, vy

title: Compute dielectric properties
action: Extract static dielectric constants for lateral and vertical polarization. Write to dielectric_properties.json.
output_schema: Array of objects with keys: system, lateral_eps, vertical_eps
